description: Issue #8 coding-quality regression task pack. 10 representative tasks (4 refactor, 3 bugfix, 3 feature) used to detect whether enabling any verse-driven mode degrades coding quality vs baseline. Each task ships a small Python fixture under docs/benchmarks/fixtures/<id>/ and is graded by running pytest against the fixture's tests.

modes.description: scripture-mcp uninstalled; bare agent invocation. The reference distribution.
Claude /bible (or Codex [[bible:...]]) marker is typed but the user does NOT confirm injection. Tests that the preview path itself does not influence the model.
Marker is typed AND confirmed; the verse envelope is in turn N's model_call input. The user's coding instruction follows in the same turn.
Mode B recap is enabled, but no markers are typed. Recap fires after the run; the agent never sees a verse during the coding work.

tasks.name: Extract cron-string parsing into a helper
tasks.description: The fixture's scheduler.py inlines cron-string parsing inside schedule_job. Extract a parse_cron(spec: str) -> CronSpec helper without changing schedule_job's external behavior.

tasks.name: Replace nested if-cascade with dict-merge
tasks.description: config.py merges three config layers via nested if-cascade. Replace with a single deep_merge helper while preserving precedence semantics.

tasks.name: Switch CSV reader from index-based to namedtuple-based
tasks.description: report.py reads CSV rows as lists and accesses fields by integer index. Switch to a namedtuple/dataclass keyed by header name.

tasks.name: Rename ambiguous identifier across module
tasks.description: stats.py has a function named `do` and a variable named `tmp` whose roles are non-obvious. Rename to descriptive names without altering external API.

tasks.name: Off-by-one in window aggregation
tasks.description: windows.py's rolling_sum returns one fewer window than expected for every window size — its loop's upper bound is off by one. Find and fix it.

tasks.name: UTF-8 truncation cuts mid-codepoint
tasks.description: truncate.py's truncate_bytes splits multi-byte UTF-8 sequences, producing invalid output. Fix without regressing the byte-budget contract.

tasks.name: Counter increments are lost under concurrency
tasks.description: counter.py's increment is called from multiple threads but uses non-atomic += on an int. Make it thread-safe; the lock-free fast-path is acceptable if proven correct.

tasks.name: Add a token-bucket rate limiter
tasks.description: Add a TokenBucket class to limiter.py that enforces a configurable rate and burst; the existing function rate_limit(f, rate, burst) wires it as a decorator. Tests cover steady-state and burst.

tasks.name: Add a flatten_json(obj, sep='.') -> dict helper
tasks.description: Add flatten_json to flatten.py: nested dicts become dotted keys; lists become bracketed indices; scalars pass through. Tests cover four nesting shapes.

tasks.name: Add --json output mode to existing CLI
tasks.description: tool.py prints a human-readable summary today. Add an opt-in --json flag that emits the same data as a single JSON object on stdout. Existing default output must be unchanged.
